bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; individual income; establishing a subtraction for firefighter pension income; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 40.+]

[+Firefighter pensions.+]

[+(a) The amount of firefighter pension income is a subtraction. +]

[+(b) For the purposes of this subdivision, "firefighter pension income" means annuity income or a lump-sum payment from a public retirement plan based on service as a firefighter, as defined in section 299N.01, subdivision 3. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; individual income; establishing a subtraction for firefighter pension income; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 290.0132, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 40.

Firefighter pensions.

(a) The amount of firefighter pension income is a subtraction.

(b) For the purposes of this subdivision, "firefighter pension income" means annuity income or a lump-sum payment from a public retirement plan based on service as a firefighter, as defined in section 299N.01, subdivision 3.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025.
additions: (a) The amount of firefighter pension income is a subtraction.

(b) For the purposes of this subdivision, "firefighter pension income" means annuity income or a lump-sum payment from a public retirement plan based on service as a firefighter, as defined in section 299N.01, subdivision 3.
This section is effective for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025.
